phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Sectoral Financial Positions
canonical_requirement: Complete holder-by-issuer financial stocks and transactions by represented instrument on the RMD sector boundary.

noncanonical_evidence_boundary.F2: F2M and external/aggregate components do not complete total F2.
noncanonical_evidence_boundary.F4: Only an unconditional rank-unique partial core is materialized; unresolved bilateral cells remain.
noncanonical_evidence_boundary.F5: Component evidence and rank constraints leave zero unique bilateral total-F5 cells.
noncanonical_evidence_boundary.F6: Aggregate-only rank boundary; zero unconditional unique bilateral cells.
noncanonical_evidence_boundary.F7: Aggregate evidence exists but bilateral stock/flow positions remain unidentified.
noncanonical_evidence_boundary.F8: Aggregate-only rank boundary; zero unconditional unique bilateral cells.

blocker.reason: The requested reference mode is itself the multi-instrument accounting state. Promoting it while six of seven canonical instruments remain incomplete would turn partial/component/aggregate constraints into a fictitious complete observed reference series.

prohibited_shortcuts: count a component artifact as the complete instrument
convert aggregate rank constraints into bilateral observations
convert missing or TBD cells to zero
allocate unidentified bilateral cells by shares or residual balancing
describe F3-only or partial-instrument diagnostics as the full sectoral financial-position reference mode
reopen_condition: Promote only after the canonical Accounting Readiness Gate establishes complete stock and flow matrices for every instrument required by the declared sectoral-financial-positions boundary, or after an explicit narrower reference-mode boundary is scientifically justified and preregistered.
